items.summary: Join us on 17 September for a unique opportunity to gain expert-led insights through thought leadership and industry panels featuring top professionals in sustainability, supply chain and procurement.

items.summary: Next week, edie is hosting a new webinar exploring the growing interest in bio-based materials.

items.title: Spain calls for creation of EU climate adaptation fund mobilised by fossil fuel tax
items.summary: Spain’s vice president and minister for Ecological Transition, Sara Aagesen, has spearheaded a call for the creation of an EU climate adaptation fund.

items.title: 上千人搶當綠領！淨零測驗到考率破92%企業高管醫師也來考 最小僅17歲
items.summary: 環境部推動淨零轉型再邁關鍵一步，環境部淨零綠領人才培育課程今年第2次全國集中測驗於本周5在全國12個考區同步登場。本次測驗共吸引近1000名完成48小時培訓課程的學員報名應試，現場到考率超過92%，顯見產業對綠領人才的殷切需求。

items.title: 推廣淨零綠生活 南市環保局辦理「循流好市」永續市集 | 台灣好新聞
items.summary: 您使用的瀏覽器版本較舊，已不再受支援。建議您更新瀏覽器版本，以獲得最佳使用體驗。為推廣淨零綠生活與環境永續理念，臺南市政府環保局5日於麻豆區總爺藝文中心辦理「循流好市」永續市集，並結合「2026 Mattauw大地藝術季」共同登場。

items.title: 「環境部淨零綠領人才培育課程」測驗近千名應試 到考率逾九成 | Newtalk
items.summary: 您使用的瀏覽器版本較舊，已不再受支援。建議您更新瀏覽器版本，以獲得最佳使用體驗。「環境部淨零綠領人才培育課程」今年第2次全國集中測驗於今（5）日舉行，近千名完成48小時課程的學員應試，到考率超過92%。環境部長彭啓明表示，淨零轉型是各行各業都要面對的課題，企業亟需能把專業與淨零知能結合的跨域人才，他期許這些學員能把所學帶進未來的求職或工作中，成為台灣淨零轉型的重要力量。

items.title: TWO WEEKS TO GO: Preparing UK businesses for European sustainability reporting requirements
items.summary: With just two weeks to go, edie’s new webinar will explore what the European Sustainability Reporting Standards for Third-Country Groups (ESRS-TC) could mean for UK-headquartered businesses.

items.title: Analysis: UK solar power hits record high over summer 2026
items.summary: Solar power generation in the UK reached a new record over the summer of 2026, as temperatures across the nation soared, according to new analysis by Carbon Brief.

items.title: How this summer’s heat and drought impacted crops in Europe – in six charts
items.summary: Farmers around Europe are dealing with the aftermath of a summer of extreme heat , drought and wildfires that were exacerbated by climate change.

items.title: Reusable food and drink packaging: The case for glass
items.summary: As the Government explores the potential of reusable food and drink packaging systems, environment and circularity director at British Glass, Jenni Richards, explains why, with the right investment and support, glass is the perfect candidate.
